create_train_eval_data_loader_map_provid: create a TrainEvalDataLoaderMapProvider instance to manage train, val, and test data loaders for 3D scene datasets
get_data_loader_map: get a DataLoaderMap with train, val, and test loaders from a DatasetMap using get_data_loader_map
make_eval_data_loader: make an eval DataLoader from a test dataset using pre-saved eval batches via _make_eval_data_loader
make_generic_data_loader: make a generic DataLoader for train or val datasets with configurable batch size and scene sampling
configure_scene_batch_sampler: configure a SceneBatchSampler with images_per_seq_options and consecutive frame sampling for few-view setups
